title: Sherman accounts of orbs and giant wolf-like creatures heading toward Dry Gulch Creek
place_text: Dry Gulch Creek, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah

tellings.quote: There had been accounts, in fact, going back to the Shermans, accounts of orbs of light traveling that direction or and and even these giant wolves, wolf-like creatures that it proceeded to head out toward that part of the ranch and disappeared.

plain: In the 1990s, the Shermans, a family who lived on Skinwalker Ranch in Utah, a property known for reports of strange happenings, are said to have seen glowing orbs of light moving toward an area called Dry Gulch Creek. They also told of giant wolf-like creatures heading toward the same spot and then vanishing. The ranch's current owner, Brandon Fugal, passes on these stories from the family to show that one part of the ranch has long drawn strange things.
